title: Static Black
description:
Venture Into the DarknessFace your fears and survive as many floors of this cursed place as you can. Gain blessings to improve your capabilities, including passive buffs and active items to help you against the hordes. But watch out, if your batteries run out, you won't know what's coming next...

Collect BlessingsFind over 30+ different blessings that aid you in your struggle against the darkness. Gain a new blessing every time you complete a floor, and try to see how far you can go.

Keep MovingMonsters you find in your journey have many weaknesses to learn and exploit, perhaps it's best to not always try to fight them head on. Avoid them and keep going, and try to search for ammo and health packs along the way.
description_short: A survival horror roguelike where you try to survive in the dark. Collect blessings and maintain your battery level to survive.
